K-Pop Bands Stray Kids and BTS Opt Out of Grammy Race

K-pop group Stray Kids has announced they are stepping away from the Grammy race, following a similar decision by BTS. The band stated that winning awards was never their goal. The 2027 Grammy awards are mentioned in relation to this decision.
